instruction: Design a system that combines the barrel shifter module from problem 1 with the 4-to-16 decoder module from problem 2. The system should take in an 8-bit input and use the decoder module to output a 16-bit signal indicating which of the 16 possible 4-bit input values are present. The system should then use the barrel shifter to shift the input based on a 2-bit shift amount and a shift direction input. The output should be the shifted input value corresponding to the highest active decoder output.
